# Pull Request

## Description

Provide a clear and concise description of what this PR does.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Code refactoring
- [ ] Test addition/improvement
- [ ] Build system/CI improvement

## Related Issues

Fixes #(issue number)
Relates to #(issue number)

## Changes Made

List the key changes made in this PR:

- Change 1
- Change 2
- Change 3

## Testing Performed

Describe the testing you've done:

### Build Testing
- [ ] Builds successfully with `make`
- [ ] No compiler warnings
- [ ] Builds without SDL2 (if applicable)
- [ ] All tests pass with `make test`

### Functional Testing
- [ ] Tested in single player mode
- [ ] Tested in dual player mode
- [ ] Tested in co-op mode
- [ ] Tested in training mode
- [ ] Tested in skeet mode
- [ ] Tested with keyboard controls
- [ ] Tested with gamepad/joystick (if applicable)

### Terminal Testing
- [ ] Tested on xterm
- [ ] Tested on gnome-terminal or other emulator
- [ ] Tested at 80x24 size
- [ ] Tested at larger sizes
- [ ] Verified terminal state restoration on exit

### Performance Testing
- [ ] Maintains 60fps at standard terminal size
- [ ] No memory leaks (valgrind clean)
- [ ] CPU usage is reasonable

## Screenshots/Demo

If applicable, add screenshots or screen recordings to demonstrate the changes.

## Documentation Updates

- [ ] Updated README.md (if user-facing changes)
- [ ] Updated FEATURES.md (if new features)
- [ ] Updated MODE-GUIDE.md (if gameplay changes)
- [ ] Updated CLAUDE.md (if architecture changes)
- [ ] Updated CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] Added/updated code comments
- [ ] Updated CONTRIBUTING.md (if workflow changes)

## Breaking Changes

If this PR includes breaking changes, describe:
- What breaks
- Why it was necessary
- Migration path for users

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project's code style guidelines
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing tests pass locally with my changes
